description: This file defines the interface GroupRolesWritePlatformService, which specifies methods for creating, updating, and deleting group roles within the Fineract portfolio group service.

classes.name: GroupRolesWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining operations for managing group roles, including creating, updating, and deleting roles.

methods.name: createRole
methods.description: Creates a new group role based on the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: updateRole
methods.description: Updates an existing group role using the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: deleteRole
methods.description: Deletes a group role identified by the given ruleId.
